units.source_text: 昭和七年，我和直木三十五在伊东的暖香园看见吴清源同名人对弈，名人让二子。

en.t: In the seventh year of Showa, Naoki Sanjugo and I saw Wu Qingyuan play a game against the Meijin at Dankoen in Ito, with the Meijin giving him a two-stone handicap.

units.source_text: 六年前的那个时候，他身穿藏青底白碎花纹的筒袖和服，手指修长，脖颈白皙，

en.t: At that time six years earlier, he was wearing a kimono with narrow sleeves, dark blue ground, and small white floral patterns; his fingers were long and slender, and the nape of his neck was fair,

units.source_text: 使人感到他具有高贵少女的睿智和哀愁，如今又加上年轻僧人般的高贵品格。

en.t: making one feel that he possessed the wisdom and sorrow of a noble young girl, and now he had acquired the noble dignity of a young monk as well.

units.source_text: 从耳朵到脸形，都是一副高贵相。

en.t: From his ears to the shape of his face, everything about him had an air of nobility.

units.source_text: 过去从未有人给我留下过这样鲜明的天才印象。

en.t: Never before had anyone left me with such a vivid impression of genius.
